caption:
One pot, two dinners. The second one cost almost nothing but the second container.

Doubling the recipe adds five minutes tonight and takes a whole cooking night off the week.

For whoever cooks once and eats twice.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a pot of soup steaming at the left and two empty containers waiting at the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks toward the pot, its eyes go wide with a pulse, and two containers fill up one after the other and get their lids. A bubble says two dinners. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me cooking once, eating twice.
